observations.code_quote: Note: developer.brex.com serves an SPA (the openapi.json URLs return HTML), but the llms.txt index plus the per-API markdown mirrors (e.g. https://developer.brex.com/openapi/team\_api.md) list every operation with its literal path. Brex ships nine APIs — Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel — and the connector covers pieces of only four. The connector now also exposes /v2/accounts/cash as its own table, alongside the fan-out it already drove.
